commitMessage: fix: disable Triton on Windows — LLVM headers incompatible with MSVC
notes: Fixed CUDA backend init/failover path so metadata probing does not create contexts on failed GPUs, Java publishes auto-detected available devices to native immediately, LaunchContext initializes only the current device lazily, P2P reports real topology, and non-P2P cross-device transfers remain enabled. Native/backend build and Java backend rebuild passed; focused cross-device binary-op test passed with native device-ID assertions.
